detail.title: Speed Measuring System
detail.overview: Compare Favourite HWS1600D Speed Measuring System Key Points 1. Monitors real-time conditions through LCD display or the web page of the device. 2. Supports traffic flow statistics by minute. 3. Detection of traffic violations such as overspeed, underspeed, wrong-way driving, and more. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

On-site Speed Measurement Error Range: V.White Balance: Full-automation;High color temperature;Partial auto;Low color temperature;Autocolor temerature
On-site Speed Measurement Error Range: V.Data Ports: 1 RS-232 port, 1 RS-485 port, 1 1000M Ethernet port, 1 USB3.0 port
On-site Speed Measurement Error Range: V.Lithium Battery Port: 1 port of 14.4 V 12.12 AH lithium battery
On-site Speed Measurement Error Range: V.Power Input Port: 24 VDC;power adapter supports 100 VAC to 240 VAC, 50 Hz–60 Hz
On-site Speed Measurement Error Range: V.Power Output Port: 1 12 VDC power output port, with maximum power of 12 W

Special Function.Multi-target Tracking and Recognition: Recognizes more than 64 vehicles at distance of 15 m–60 m (49.21 ft–196.85 ft)
Special Function.Composite Image: Yes, 1, 2, 3 or 4 snapshot (s) can be composited, and composition method can be selected
Special Function.3G/4G Frequency Range: LTE FDD:B1/B3/B7/B8/B20/B28 LTE TDD:B38/B40 WCDMA:B1/B8 GSM:900/1800 MHz
Special Function.3G/4G Power Transmission: LTE: Power class3: 23 dBm ± 2 dB WCDMA: Power class3: 24 dBm+1/-3 dB GSM: Power class0: 30 dBm ± 2 dB (GSM1800) Power class5: 33 dBm ± 2 dB (GSM900)
Special Function.Speed Overlay: Overlays vehicle speed to the front or rear side of a vehicle in the video image
Special Function.Video Storage: Records and stores videos of traffic violations by periods
Special Function.Storage Space: Supports setting picture and video storage quota to ensure enough storage space of pictures
Special Function.Remote Control: Remote control through the web interface or the client
Special Function.OSD Overlay: Supports overlaying date, time, location, plate number, plate color, model, vehicle speed, speed limit, radar direction, violation code, device No., anti-counterfeit code, and more
Special Function.Watermark: Watermark verification on the web interface
Special Function.Image Tampering Prevention: Yes. Watermark is available for pictures and videos

General.Operating Voltage: 24 VDC; power adapter supports 100 VAC to 240 VAC, 50 Hz–60 Hz
